dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: You have mountains, and bodies of water, food and fun, and everything to like!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Besides, you're so kind to me. I really do love it here.

choices.text: I'm happy when I'm with you.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Oh, really? Come, come, lend me your ear so I can tell you a secret.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Truthfully, I feel the same way.

choices.text: Isn't it about time you invited me over?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Well, sure I can! If going to the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor won't scare you silly.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: As long as I'm not busy, you're welcome any time!
